programs.title: Menyimpan Rindu
programs.desc: Based on the real-life experiences of A Zhu and Yan Ji-cang, Menyimpan Rindu portrays a family's journey through life's many ups and downs. As they struggle to find stable employment and overcome financial challenges, their relationships are tested by sacrifice, separation, and emotional hardship. Guided by compassion, perseverance, and unwavering family support, the series delivers an inspiring story about hope, resilience, and the enduring bonds that keep a family together.
